name: Death House
source:
Dungeons and Dragons meets Choose your Adventure in this fan-made visual novel that's based on the dungeon "Death House" in the beginning of the Curse of Strahd campaign. In the game you play as the humble moon druid, Faylen. Unlock all the secrets of Death House in this survival gothic-horror themed visual novel.

[From [url=https://goddess-of-gales.itch.io/death-house]Itch.io[/url]]
